# Digital Doorway Marketing

> Digital Doorway Marketing designs and builds custom websites for local businesses (restaurants, salons, trades, clinics, gyms, shops, landscapers, and more) for a flat $499, one-time. The price includes the first year of hosting, domain registration, SSL security, 5 business email addresses, local SEO, QR code generation, a professional audio welcome message, and a CRM customized for the client's industry. Founded by Marv Reeves, based in Seattle, WA.

## The $499 website

- Price: $499, one-time. Includes the first year (12 months) of hosting, domain registration, SSL security, 5 business email addresses, local SEO, QR code generation, a professional audio welcome message, and a customized CRM. No monthly fees for 12 months.
- Included: custom design (not a template), mobile-first build, copywriting help, Google-ready SEO basics (titles, descriptions, speed, map listing hookup), contact forms and click-to-call, two rounds of changes, launch, and a walkthrough of the finished site. The client owns the site.
- CRM: set up for the client's industry, with stages, fields, and reminders that match how the business works (for example quotes and jobs for trades, appointments and rebooking for salons, inquiries and events for caterers). Website contact-form inquiries land in it automatically. Included for the first 12 months (a $419 value).
- Every client gets more than one design direction to choose from.
- Payment: online at checkout on the website, through Square (card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay).

## After the first year (optional)

- Business Bundle: $49.95/month. Domain, hosting, SSL security, 5 business email accounts, local SEO, QR codes, the audio welcome message, and the customized CRM.
- Or individually: website hosting $14.95/month, domain name registration $9.95/year, SSL security $5.95/month, 5 professional email addresses $59/year, local SEO $19.95/month, QR code generation $5.95/month, audio welcome message $9.95/month, customized CRM $34.95/month.
- Services can be bought individually on the homepage (#buy-services) through Square.

## How it works

1. Tell us about your business (a short conversation).
2. We design your site.
3. You say what to change (two rounds).
4. We launch it, with hosting, your domain, SSL, business email, local SEO, QR codes, your audio welcome message, and your CRM set up.
